Welcome to my portfolio

Hello, I'm Deepika Saini.

Hello! I am Deepika Saini, currently pursuing a Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC) at K.R. Mangalam University. My academic journey is helping me discover the exciting world of media, communication, and storytelling.

I am interested in how stories, ideas, and information connect people through different media platforms. I enjoy learning creative skills, exploring new perspectives, and experimenting with photography, video-making, and digital content. Through this portfolio, I am sharing a little about what inspires me and the creative journey I am building.

What I love doing

My Hobbies

My hobbies give me opportunities to explore, observe, and express myself. Each one helps me experience the world in a different way and turn everyday moments into stories.

Exploring the World

I love discovering new places, cultures, traditions, and experiences. Exploring the world helps me gain fresh perspectives, understand different lifestyles, and stay curious about the people and places around me.

Travelling

I enjoy travelling to new destinations, experiencing different surroundings, and making unforgettable memories. Every journey gives me something new to learn and stories that I can cherish and share.

Making Videos

I enjoy capturing everyday moments, special experiences, and creative ideas through videos. Visual storytelling allows me to present experiences in an interesting way and share the emotions behind each moment.

Photography

I love capturing beautiful moments, landscapes, and small details through my camera. Photography encourages me to notice light, composition, and the stories hidden in ordinary scenes.

Video Editing

I enjoy editing videos by experimenting with transitions, effects, music, and sequencing. It gives me the creative freedom to turn raw clips into polished and engaging visual stories.

Things that inspire me

My Interests

My interests encourage me to keep learning and help shape the kind of communicator and digital creator I hope to become.

Book Reading

I enjoy reading books because they expand my knowledge, imagination, and vocabulary. Reading introduces me to different perspectives and ideas, strengthens my understanding, and inspires me to communicate thoughtfully.

Content Creating

I am interested in creating engaging digital content for social media platforms. I enjoy exploring creative ideas, planning content, making reels, and experimenting with different formats. My BJMC studies are helping me build a foundation in communication and storytelling that I hope to apply to future media and content-creation projects.
